adopt: Pair a phone with a Steam Deck and start a stream, then read back which route it used.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
Streaming a game from a Steam Deck to a phone means pairing two apps by hand, guessing which address the Deck is on today, and finding out it routed through the internet only when it stutters.

Install
not yet published; builds in-tree

Commands
  awplay

Quick start
  pip install -e.
  awplay probe steamdeck # is Sunshine / Steam Remote Play there? mesh, lan or internet?
  AWPLAY_SUNSHINE_PASSWORD=... awplay pair steamdeck --pin 1234 --cert-sha256 <from probe>
  awplay phone state # a phone-local Steam session, over adb
  awplay phone launch 1145360
  awplay --self-test
synopsis: Stream a game from your own handheld or PC to your phone, over your own network.
